data.title: Lab-grown human brain cells ‘recorded passage of time’
data.description: PARIS - Peppercorn-sized clumps of human brain cells grown in a laboratory for a record seven years aged similarly to those inside our heads, suggesting they “recorded the passage of time”, scientists said on Wednesday.

data.title: Runoff reaches downstream districts of Nan, two killed
data.description: NAN - The Interior Ministry has warned people living along the rising Nan River in this northern province to move their belongings and bedridden relatives to safe places to escape the runoff from upstream Pua district.

data.title: UK media skewered for ‘hounding’ black academic to death
data.description: LONDON - The British press is once again in the spotlight for its methods, this time over accusations that its full-throttle coverage of plagiarism allegations against the Cambridge academic Jason Arday led to his untimely death.

data.title: Ukraine MPs approve new defence minister after divisive reshuffle
data.description: KYIV - Lawmakers approved Ukraine’s new defence minister on Wednesday, a month after a reshuffle that triggered a public backlash after the dismissal of his popular predecessor Mykhailo Fedorov.

data.title: Iran warns Gulf countries against helping US
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran's armed forces warned Gulf countries against assisting the US military on Wednesday, hours after the United Arab Emirates announced it was severing economic ties with Tehran following new attacks on shipping.

data.title: France’s historically hot summer brings 7,300 excess deaths
data.description: PARIS - France has seen more than 7,300 excess deaths during heatwaves so far this year, health authorities said on Wednesday, as the country has also endured a record number of hot days since mid-June, according to an AFP analysis.

data.title: Russia, Ukraine exchange 103 captured soldiers each
data.description: MOSCOW - Russia and Ukraine each handed over 103 captured soldiers on Wednesday, both countries said, in the latest exchange between the warring sides.

data.title: Pre-election violence feared in polarised Israel
data.description: JERUSALEM - Warnings are multiplying that violence could break out between rival political camps ahead of Israel’s election on Oct 27, with powerful figures including top government ministers accused of incitement against opponents.

data.title: Queen Camilla ‘struggled’ to keep husband’s cancer private
data.description: LONDON - Queen Camilla has spoken about the difficulty of not revealing King Charles III had cancer when she visited a support charity shortly after her husband had been diagnosed with the disease.

data.title: Tributes pour in on passing of Ray MacDonald
data.description: Tributes have poured in from Thailand’s entertainment and travel communities following the passing of Ray MacDonald on Wednesday at the age of 49.

data.title: Flash flood and landslide warnings for northern provinces
data.description: The Thai Meteorological Department has predicted heavy rainfall in the North and the Northeast until Friday and warns of run-offs, flash floods and landslides in several provinces.

data.title: Khon Kaen police take up temple land dispute
data.description: KHON KAEN - Police in this northeastern province are investigating a complaint against an estate administrator accused of giving false statements about a land title deed at the centre of a bitter dispute over the future of a forest temple.

data.title: Inside Wat Phra Kaew Wang Na, a rare window into Bangkok’s royal past
data.description: For a limited period, Wat Phra Kaew Wang Na is opening its historic ordination hall, revealing centuries of royal history, Buddhist art and remarkable murals.

data.title: Portugal bans full-face veils
data.description: LISBON — Portugal's president has enacted a law pushed by the far right banning the concealment of faces in public, a measure widely seen as targeting Muslim women wearing a full-face veil.

data.title: Migrant child registration probe expands nationwide
data.description: Thai authorities are expanding investigations into widespread use of fake birth and ID registrations from Bangkok to all provinces as the issue jeopardises national security, according to a deputy interior minister.

data.title: Kyrgios admits 'huge mistake' after failing test for cocaine
data.description: LONDON — Australian tennis star Nick Kyrgios said on Wednesday he had made "a huge mistake" after he was provisionally suspended for testing positive for cocaine.

data.title: Foreign investors show growing interest in Bangkok and Phuket condos
data.description: CBRE figures show foreign buyers accounted for 32% of central Bangkok condominium purchases, while its transaction data put the share at 67% in Bang Tao and Cherng Talay.

data.title: HYROX Targets Olympic Sport Status Amid Rapid Growth in Thailand
data.description: HYROX is looking beyond its rapid growth in Thailand, with the global hybrid fitness brand targeting Olympic sport status while expanding its reach nationwide, a HYROX manager says.

data.title: Happitat Launch Ignites Retail Battle for Bangkok's East
data.description: CP Axtra's 15-billion-baht Happitat opens this week, sharpening competition with Bangkok Mall, Central and Bitec for Bangna's shoppers.

data.title: 11-year-old loses B1 million in Pokémon card scam
data.description: An 11-year-old boy who said he lost more than 1 million baht buying a rare Pokémon card is among at least 25 victims who have filed complaints with police, claiming they were duped by a man who promised to source sought-after collectibles from overseas.

data.title: Missing man found drowned after two-day search in Korat
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA - The body of a 39-year-old man reported missing since Sunday has been found floating in a pond near his home in Non Sung district of this northeastern province.

data.title: Thailand tightens border surveillance over Yangon cholera outbreak
data.description: Thailand has stepped up cholera surveillance at borders and hospitals after Yangon reported about 500 severe diarrhoea cases, with nine infections confirmed.

data.title: Department of International Trade Promotion drives Thai businesses into global e-commerce
data.description: Bangkok– The Department of International Trade Promotion (DITP), through its Digital Commerce Market Bureau,organisedthe“TOPTHAI Cross-Border E-Commerce Day 2026”under the theme“TOPTHAI Global Gateway”on August 17–18, 2026, from 9amto 5pmat the Le Grand Ballroom, Sofitel Bangkok Sukhumvit. The event was held in collaboration with government agencies, private-sector organisations, and e-commerce partners to enhance the capabilities of Thai entrepreneurs in cross-border e-commerce and create greater opportunities for business expansion into international markets.

data.title: Thai schools hold shooting response drills
data.description: Thai ⁠schools ⁠conducted active shooter drills on ​Wednesday, as authorities moved to strengthen security measures two ​weeks after a 14-year-old opened ‌fire at a school in Nonthaburi and killed seven people including himself, after killing his grandparents earlier.

data.title: Bangkok Auto Salon 2026 gears up to drive tourism, innovation and car culture in Bangkok
data.description: <p>Bangkok is set to become the centre of ASEAN's car culture scene this August as Bangkok Auto Salon 2026 rolls into BITEC Bangna, bringing together some of the region's finest custom cars, tuning specialists and motorsport attractions in an event expected to attract enthusiasts, tourists and industry professionals from across Asia.</p>

data.title: Generali Thailand Appoints Grace Allison Toh as Chief Agency Officer
data.description: Generali Thailand announces the appointment of Grace Allison Toh (Ally) as Chief Agency Officer (CAO), effective on 17 August 2026. In her new role, Allison will lead Generali Thailand’s Agency Channel, with a focus on expanding its agency network, developing future leaders, enhancing agent capabilities and customer excellence.

data.title: Phuket teen Nene Royal heads to US for AGT live quarter-final
data.description: Nene Royal has flown from Phuket to the United States for the second America’s Got Talent live quarter-final on August 25, calling on Thai fans worldwide to support her.
